description: This file defines an Angular service class ApiService that provides methods to interact with a backend API for managing events, user profiles, authentication, and RSVP operations. It uses Angular's HttpClient for HTTP requests and handles token-based authorization.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: An Angular service class providing methods to perform CRUD operations and user interactions with an event management backend API.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Fetches a list of events, with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single event by its ID.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event with provided details.

methods.name: editEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event identified by its ID with specified changes.

methods.name: rsvpToEvent
methods.description: Submits an RSVP status ('going', 'interested', 'not_going') for a specific event.

methods.name: getMyRSVPs
methods.description: Retrieves RSVPs associated with the current user.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event specified by its ID.

methods.name: getMyEvents
methods.description: Fetches events organized by the current user.

methods.name: getMyProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the profile information of the current user.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the current user's profile with provided data.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, returning an auth token and user info.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user account, returning an auth token and user info.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by removing stored JWT token.

ctags.name: API_BASE
ctags.pattern: /^const API_BASE = '\/api'; \/\/ could be replaced by process.env.API_URL in real env$/

ctags.name: httpParams
ctags.pattern: /^    const httpParams = new HttpParams({ fromObject: params || {} });$/
